walkthroughs.body_html:
Area of Study 6: Innovations in Music 1900 to Present — a core area of A-Level Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area of Study 6: Innovations in Music 1900 to Present brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area of Study 6: Innovations in Music 1900 to Present.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
